presentationProfile.title: GoDaddy Domain
presentationProfile.description: GoDaddy helps businesses register domains and manage DNS, renewals, and domain settings

ContactsValidate.description: Validates contact details against the requested domains or TLDs. The.uk TLD requires full domain names.

available.description: Checks whether the specified domain can be purchased.

availableBulk.description: Checks whether each submitted domain can be purchased.

cancel.description: Submits a cancellation request for the purchased domain.

cancelPrivacy.description: Submits a request to cancel privacy for the domain.

deleteV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomain.description: Cancels the most recent user action of the selected type for the domain.
Cancels a pending change of registrant for the specified domain.

domainsForwardsDelete.description: Removes the forwarding configuration for the fully qualified domain name.

domainsForwardsGet.description: Returns the forwarding configuration for the fully qualified domain name.

domainsForwardsPost.description: Creates a forwarding configuration for the fully qualified domain name.

domainsForwardsPut.description: Updates the forwarding configuration for the fully qualified domain name.

get.description: Returns details for the specified domain.

getAgreement.description: Returns the legal agreements needed for the selected TLDs and add-ons.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomain.description: Returns details for the specified domain.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainAct.description: Returns the most recent actions for the specified domain.
Returns the most recent action of the selected type for the domain.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainCha.description: Returns change-of-registrant details for the specified domain.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainPri.description: Returns the delivery settings for the domain privacy email address.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsNotificat.description: Returns the next available domain notification for the customer.
Returns the notification types the customer has opted into.
Returns the data schema for the specified notification type.

getV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsRegisterS.description: Returns the registration fields required for the selected TLD.

getV2DomainsMaintenancesMaintenanceid.description: Returns details for the specified upcoming maintenance window.

getV2DomainsUsageYyyymm.description: Returns API request counts for the specified month. Usage data is retained for three months.

list.description: Returns domains associated with the specified shopper.

patchV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainC.description: Updates contact information for the specified domain.

patchV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainP.description: Updates how messages to the domain privacy email address are delivered.

postV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainRe.description: Purchases a restore for the domain to bring it out of redemption.

postV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainTr.description: Purchases and starts or restarts a transfer for the specified domain.
Accepts the incoming transfer for the specified domain.

postV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsRegister.description: Purchases and registers the specified domain.

purchase.description: Purchases and registers the specified domain.

purchasePrivacy.description: Purchases privacy for the specified domain.

putV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsDomainNam.description: Replaces the existing name servers for the specified domain.

putV2CustomersCustomeridDomainsNotificat.description: Opts the customer in to notifications for the submitted types.

recordAdd.description: Adds the submitted DNS records to the domain.

recordDeleteTypeName.description: Deletes DNS records matching the specified type and name.

recordGet.description: Returns DNS records matching the specified domain, type, and name.

recordReplace.description: Replaces all DNS records for the domain.

recordReplaceType.description: Replaces DNS records of the selected type for the domain.

recordReplaceTypeName.description: Replaces DNS records matching the specified type and name.

schema.description: Returns the registration fields required for the selected TLD.

suggest.description: Returns alternate domain suggestions based on a seed domain, keywords, or purchase history.

tlds.description: Returns TLDs supported and enabled for sale.

transferIn.description: Purchases and starts or restarts a transfer for the specified domain.

update.description: Updates supported details for the specified domain.

updateContacts.description: Updates contact information for the specified domain.

validate.description: Validates purchase details against the registration schema for the selected TLD.

verifyEmail.description: Resends the verification email for the domain registrant contact.
